hy2_div_sign_convention.proposed_action: Enable HY2-DIV to provide corrective antisymmetric torque

explanation: The field 'correcting_pct' = de * dt < 0 means divergence_error and divergence_torque have opposite signs
For correcting behavior: when de > 0, dt must be < 0 (opposite signs) -> torque opposes error
For accelerating behavior: when de > 0, dt must be > 0 (same signs) -> torque amplifies error
Per-joint PD: 99% accelerating = de * dt > 0 = same signs = AMPLIFYING divergence
HY2-DIV: should be ~99% correcting = de * dt < 0 = opposite signs = OPPOSING divergence
